items.evidence: Continued to use EPS as the performance criterion for the Corporate Executive Bonus Plan because it measures profitability
Continued to use return on common equity (ROCE) equaling or exceeding cost of equity (COE) as the performance goal for the 2016 PBRSUs
COE is calculated using the Capital Asset Pricing Model (CAP-M), which is a commonly used financial metric
The Compensation Committee selected cumulative EPS as the performance criterion because it provides a comprehensive measure of the company's profitability
